name: Jake
title: Head Striking Coach / Owner
bio: Jake is a former professional and amateur fighter in both boxing and MMA. He competed in Golden Gloves and worked with the Hungarian national team. Jake is an official coach with USA Boxing and currently coaches and trains aspiring amateur/professional boxers and MMA fighters from Portland and Washington. His training regimes tend to emphasize combat adaptability, explosive power, agility, and technical efficiency.
excerpt: A USA Boxing coach, Jake develops amateur and professional fighters through adaptable, explosive, and technically efficient training.
